response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT c.*, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT source, cnt AS count, cnt * 1.0 / total AS share_of_total, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average_by FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

assumptions.assumption: Coverage is measured as the number of scanspatial records per funding source, joined to projects by arcref = arcregistry with an inner join. Spatial rows whose project is missing are dropped.
Projects with a NULL fundflux are excluded because they do not belong to a funding source. This also keeps them out of the average and the total.
The average is the mean of the per-source counts. Share is count divided by the sum of all counts, as a fraction from 0 to 1 with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: Coverage is the number of distinct projects with spatial data per funding source, not the number of spatial records.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT c.*, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT source, cnt AS count, cnt * 1.0 / total AS share_of_total, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average_by FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC
